title: Ui Browser Default Suppress
description: Inside the ui suppress the browser default Tab focus traversal and native right-click context menu via applyElementsSurfaceChrome.
summary: Added document capture listeners via `installElementsSurfaceBrowserDefaultSuppression`, wired from `applyElementsSurfaceChrome` so every Elements shell suppresses the native context menu and default Tab focus traversal outside `isUiTypingTarget` fields. Vitest covers context menu + Tab on plain div vs text input. `@semio-tech/ui-react:test` 115/115 pass.
